title: Topbar Plus Api For Executor
features:
The script above is a sample script for Topbar Plus. If you want to use it for a personal project, please join the Discord server and read the API Reference.

Avoid using Topbar+ in games that already have Topbar Plus in that location, otherwise the game's Topbar Plus will be obscured or conflict will occur.

Topbar+ is a fork of Topbar Plus from BenforeverHD. Our product is a fork of his product for Executor, and is not an official product from BenforeverHD.

Topbar+ is a product for Executors; if you need the Studio version, please find the original version on the Roblox Studio Forum.
script:
-- Load TopbarPlus
local Icon = loadstring(game:HttpGet(
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Therealtobu/Topbar-Plus-For-Executor/main/init.lua"
))()

-- ── Topbar button ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Icon.new()
    :setLabel("Example")
    :setImage(16086868244, "Deselected")
    :setImage(16086868447, "Selected")
